IncidentBot: [ALERT] repeated cross-region failovers detected for route=/v1/generate model=redwood-v1-13b service=redwood-api; pattern: us-east -> us-west -> eu -> us-east over 7m, 5xx spike and latency tail increase. current error-rate(5m)=14.6%
Alice Tran: oncall (eng-sre) responding. Paging @Miguel Costa + @Priya Nair. Please grab routing traces, probe logs, and runtime OOM/eviction traces. :rotating_light:
Miguel Costa: on it. pulling router logs and health-probe traces now. quick grep of router shows: 
```n2026-11-02T03:14:10Z INFO route=us-east -> fallback=us-west reason=probe_fail seq=1
2026-11-02T03:14:12Z INFO route=us-west -> fallback=eu reason=probe_fail seq=2
2026-11-02T03:14:14Z INFO route=eu -> fallback=us-east reason=probe_fail seq=3
```
Miguel Costa: looks like probes are triggering on single failures. probe interval=2s failure_threshold=1 in global config.
Priya Nair: pulling runtime metrics. us-west runtime shows KV eviction spikes and one `oom_kill` at 03:14:11Z. us-east shows threadpool saturation during the second failover. EU shows increased GC pauses corresponding to 03:14:14Z.
Liam O'Connor: Support reports 5 customer tickets for timeouts/500s in the 03:14-03:21 window: CUST-2202, CUST-2205, CUST-2209, CUST-2210, CUST-2214. Notified account team for enterprise customer RX-31.
Alice Tran: immediate mitigation plan: 1) disable cross-region automatic fallback to break the loop, 2) increase probe hysteresis/backoff, 3) restart affected runtime node(s) in us-west to clear OOM + warm kv cache. Miguel, apply the routing change ASAP.
Miguel Costa: applying: `rbctl route-policy update smart-routing --set multi_region_fallback=false --set fallback_preference=local_then_dedicated --reason="incident 1954321123 - stop circular failover"`
DeployBot: route-policy smart-routing updated by miguel.costa (reason: incident 1954321123 - stop circular failover)
Miguel Costa: change applied and propagated to edge routers. Confirming no further cross-region fallback entries in the last 30s.
Priya Nair: applying probe config change: `rbctl health-probe update --interval=4s --failure-threshold=3 --region=global --reason="reduce flapping"`
Ops-Bot: health-probe config update executed (interval=4s failure_threshold=3) by priya.nair
Priya Nair: initiating `rbctl instance restart --id=us-west-runtime-07 --wait` to clear OOM/evict storm. Restart successful; runtime recovered, KV cache warmed over ~90s.
Miguel Costa: router logs after changes: no circular fallovers in 4m, only local retries. Metrics: error-rate(5m) down to 3.8%, 95p latency from 520ms -> 140ms.
Liam O'Connor: support updated all affected customers and posted to status.redwood.ai; assigned follow-ups: CUST-2202 urgent outreach.
Alice Tran: handing long-term follow-ups to next oncall @Jen Park. Immediate followups for postmortem: (a) why did us-west runtime OOM at that time? (b) evaluate safer global defaults for probe thresholds (c) add canary gating so routers wait for two consecutive 200s from a candidate fallback region before switching.
Jen Park: taking ownership for postmortem. I'll sync with Priya on memory tuning and Miguel on router gating. I'll schedule a blameless RCA and propose defaults in the infra repo.
Alice Tran: incident mitigated at 2026-11-02T03:18:50Z. customer-impact window ~4:40. tagging for SEV2 postmortem. :white_check_mark:
